Saved CanvasViews: named paths through canvas checkpoints
|-- Durable state: CanvasHistoryRecord
|   |-- snapshots[id] -> StoredCanvasSnapshot
|   |   `-- Holds canvas content, diagram bindings, and personal view
|   `-- canvasViews.saved[viewId] -> CanvasView
|       |-- checkpointIds: the view's ordered saved path
|       |   |-- startCheckpointId: first pinned checkpoint
|       |   `-- finalCheckpointId: latest saved endpoint
|       `-- parentViewId: ancestry survives later edits
|-- Save and branch: CanvasHistory.canvasView(command)
|   |-- create: pin the current head and make it active
|   |-- save: advance the active view's saved endpoint
|   `-- Branch from parent.finalCheckpointId
|       |-- fork: create one child and open it
|       |-- alternatives: create independent children in place
|       |   |-- forkCheckpointId pins their shared starting state
|       |   `-- alternativeGroupId identifies the sibling group
|       |-- keep: save the chosen child; archive its group siblings
|       |   `-- Their descendants are archived too
|       `-- discard: archive a view and all its descendants
|-- Live editing: activeViewId + workingCopies[viewId]
|   `-- openCanvasView
|       |-- Stash the departing head as an unsaved working copy
|       |-- Resume the target's working copy or saved endpoint
|       `-- Create a fresh head while retaining the current camera
|-- Read and integrity
|   |-- canvasViews().dirty compares content with the saved endpoint
|   |-- canvasViewComparison reads pinned start and final states
|   `-- validateCanvasViews checks checkpoints and ancestry
`-- Entry points
    |-- CanvasViewControls: ancestry tree, save, fork, alternatives
    `-- CanvasViewReceiver.apply: version check and retry receipt
